title: Rollback Compare Lane Visualizer — prototype for rapid forensics across staged rollouts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design prototype to help SREs and PMs quickly compare live and historical lanes during canary / A-B rollouts. The ‘Compare Lane Visualizer’ shows parallel lane timelines (traffic %, errors, latency p95, key scalar signals), side-by-side sample outputs from the two model variants, and a commit/parameter diff strip. Primary goal is to reduce time-to-detect regressions and to make rollback decisions visible and auditable in under 3 minutes.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype surface shows at least three parallel lane timelines with independent scrubbing and synchronized time cursor
UI presents sample generation pairs for selected time ranges (min 5 paired examples) with highlight for lexical/regression diffs
Quick-revert CTA and suggested rollback reason prepopulated from top signal on lane (errors/latency/output-drift)
Exportable snapshot link to attach to incidents (PNG + timeline context)
comments: 2026-03-02 Maya Chen: Initial briefing with PM and SRE. Problem: on-call spends 10-30 minutes correlating metrics and model outputs before deciding to rollback. Hypothesis: a tightly-coupled visual comparison with recommended rollback reasons will cut time by >=50%.

2026-03-04 Sofia Martinez: First wireframes attached. High-level lanes: Traffic %, Error rate, Latency p95, Quality drift (model eval delta). Introduced ‘paired samples’ viewer for output comparison (inline diff + similarity score).

2026-03-05 Kris Rao (SRE): Reviewed wireframes. Ask: surface sampling bias when traffic is small; want confidence interval overlay. Also ensure scrubber can jump to request IDs from logs. Action: add sampled request ID list and CI shading to latency lane.

2026-03-06 Arjun Patel (Eng): Flagged performance constraints for timeline queries. We need pre-aggregated lane summaries from telemetry; ENG-5113 to provide 1m buckets. Trade-off: full-fidelity per-request data only on-demand (cost).

2026-03-08 Sofia Martinez: Built high-fidelity prototype in Figma. Included two compact modes: 'Forensics' (dense, many lanes) and 'Ops' (summary + CTA). Prototyped quick-revert flow with confirmation modal that includes suggested reason and affected routes list.

2026-03-09 Eleanor Park (PM): Design review notes: add 'confidence' badge for suggested rollback, and add a history panel listing previous rollbacks for this model-version pair. Also request logging of the decision for audit trails.

2026-03-10 UX research (Kofi Mensah): Conducted 5 guerrilla usability tests with on-call engineers. Key feedback: paired-sample diffs are the most valuable signal; users want ability to tag a sample and attach it to an incident ticket quickly. Minor friction observed when switching time ranges — need synchronized zoom controls.

2026-03-12 Sofia Martinez: Updated prototype with CI shading, sample tagging, and synchronized zoom. Pushed Storybook snippets and a demo PR. Requesting Eng review on telemetry contract and rollback API surface (ENG-5240).
decision_log: 2026-03-05: Decide to support two prototype modes (Forensics / Ops). Forensics prioritized for SRE workflows; Ops for PMs/engineers doing quick health checks.
2026-03-06: Accept telemetry trade-off — use 1m pre-aggregates for lanes, on-demand detail pull for paired-samples to reduce load on metrics DB.
2026-03-09: Include suggested rollback reasons derived from highest ranked signal (errors>latency>output-drift), but require human confirmation — no automatic rollbacks in this cycle.
2026-03-12: Expose an audit-ready 'decision snapshot' export that captures lanes, selected samples, and user rationale; stored in the incidents service (follow-up ENG task).
open_questions: How should rollout-level RBAC map to quick-revert CTA? (Product wants team-level approval for production rollbacks)
What retention window do we need for paired-samples to be useful during slow rollouts (days vs weeks)?
Should the confidence badge be a simple heuristic for now or powered by a small regressions classifier?
next_steps: Sync with ENG-5113 and ENG-5240 to finalize telemetry endpoints and rollback API contract (by 2026-03-15)
Implement a small pilot with two customers in Dedicated env to validate sample retrieval latency and UX flow (PM to coordinate)
Prepare release notes and run a tabletop ops drill with SRE team using feature-flagged prototype (target: 2026-03-22)
